purpose: New synthetic development fixture for a matched Graphmory versus Obsidian Memory for AI workflow pilot. Not an official benchmark or holdout set.
visibilityRule: A runner may expose only model_visible to either system. evaluator_only, including expected values and gold source mappings, must remain outside vaults, prompts, tool inputs, and model retrieval paths.

model_visible.sharedInstruction: Use the memory system normally. Base claims only on the provided evidence and current user authorization. Preserve old values as history when an explicitly authorized change supersedes them. Do not infer a production-ready status from an unverified message. Preserve unresolved disagreement instead of choosing a value. Cite the visible source IDs for factual claims. After each event, return one JSON object with keys outcome, answer, citations, and canonical_effect. outcome must be ANSWERED, APPLIED, ALREADY_APPLIED, BLOCKED, or TENSION. answer is a list of objects with fact, value, and valid_at when relevant. citations is a list of visible source IDs. canonical_effect briefly describes the semantic canonical-state effect; use none when no semantic change occurred.

02-approved-command-migration.invariant: Exactly one current release-verification command; preserve old command as historical.

03-exact-update-replay.invariant: No duplicate active current-command fact after exact replay.

04-weak-readiness-evidence.invariant: Do not activate a canonical claim that Cedar CLI is production-ready. A qualified raw inbox entry or unapproved proposal may be recorded separately.

scoringRules.evidenceRecall: Required gold claim-source pairs cited divided by all required gold claim-source pairs.
